title: Karmotsav 2026 - Annual Sports & Athletic Meet
desc: Grand annual athletic championship featuring march-past by all four houses, track and field events, kho-kho, kabaddi, and championship trophy ceremony.

title: Science, STEM & Robotics Innovation Expo
desc: Hands-on exhibition showcasing working robotics prototypes, electronic sensor projects, and innovative scientific models by students of Grades 3 to 10.

title: Inter-House Debate & Elocution Competition
desc: Annual English and Marathi elocution contest fostering public speaking, critical reasoning, and articulate presentation skills.

title: Parent-Teacher Progress Forum (PTM)
desc: Comprehensive academic review and developmental consultation between subject educators and parents.

title: Annual Gathering & Kalotsav Cultural Showcase
desc: Vibrant celebration featuring classical and folk dances, dramatic plays, musical choir, and annual prize distribution.

title: Republic Day Celebration & Scout March-Past
desc: National tricolor unfurling, patriotic songs, and ceremonial parade honoring India's constitutional heritage.
